provenance.observer: Existing browser-only pass-through actual device/native AudioContext/PCM summaries and CDP network. NODE_OPTIONS/AIVC_PASSIVE_OBSERVER explicitly unset on owned production launch; no native provider fetch-clone observer.
provenance.rawCustody: Ignored immutable machine-local JSON snapshots; selected deduplicated records below. No raw audio, request auth headers, credentials or provider opaque blocks.

measurementMethod.clock: Browser performance.now() marks and native AudioContext currentTime in the same long-lived document.
measurementMethod.description: Speech-end uses browser lastSpeechFrameAt proxy; first audio is scheduling mark plus actual scheduledAfterMs. STT/modelTool/TTS spans include dispatch/network/browser. Native statechange callback timing is separate from acoustic silence; async state sampling may show a few milliseconds advanced clock. CDP timestamps use their own clock and are not subtracted from browser marks.
measurementMethod.acousticReason: No calibrated independent acoustic/loopback onset, speech end or output-silence recording. Bluetooth/OS/speaker latency and actual phoneme waveforms are not measured.

devices.observations: Bounded functional route and owner hearing/quiet checks, with explicitly accepted minor unevenness retained; not glitch-free or universal echo immunity. Actual Bose Bluetooth input/default output for first groups; Yeti input/default USB Audio output for speakers, confirmed by owner. Settings48000Hz/16bit/mono/10ms/AEC+NS+AGC true.

data.text:
Here are four short points on Deepgram's **Nova-3**, sourced from its official documentation:

1. Nova-3 is Deepgram's **highest-performing general-purpose ASR model** (with no turn detection), recommended for meetings, event captioning, multi-speaker, multilingual, noisy, or far-field audio in both batch and streaming modes.

2. It delivers **industry-leading accuracy**, with a 53.4% reduction in word error rate (WER) for streaming and 47.4% for batch processing compared to competitors.

3. It ships with production-ready controls including **Keyterm Prompting, redaction, smart formatting, diarization, multilingual code-switching, and self-hosted deployment.**

4. To access the model, the exact API setting to use in your calls is **`model=nova-3`**.
